text:
zoe: quick heads-up from a probe session — people don't discover the shortcut legend. they expect a little overlay when they first use keyboard nav.

petra: do you mean like an ephemeral toast that says "Tip: press ? for shortcuts"? that could work but might be noisy.

matt: +1 on discoverability. maybe show the overlay only on first use per account (localStorage) and include a "Don't show again" checkbox.

ria: accessibility note: overlays must be dismissible by Esc and reachable by keyboard. also ensure the content is readable by screen readers — either visible DOM or aria-live announcement.

zoe: idea: on first time a user tabs into the scorecard, show a non-modal callout anchored to the top-right help icon: "Keyboard shortcuts: Enter=open diff • Space=select • Shift+A=approve. Press ? to see all. [Dismiss] [Don't show again]"

petra: love the anchor to the help icon. keeps layout stable. UX question: do we auto-focus the overlay? that might be disruptive. better to let it be visible but not steal focus.

matt: agreed. don't steal focus. but make sure the overlay has role=dialog and aria-modal=false so SRs can jump to it. add an aria-describedby to the scorecard explaining that shortcuts exist.

ria: small a11y nit: if modal role given, screen readers might treat it as a blocking dialog. use role="region" with aria-labelledby and a visible heading. announce via aria-live only when the overlay appears: "Keyboard shortcuts available. Press ? to open full list."

zoe: copy nits: prefer concise verbs: "Open diff", "Select row", "Approve". for the overlay, show both symbol + short text: e.g., ⏎ Open diff. This helps people who skim.

petra: also add a persistent entry in the top-right help menu labeled "Keyboard & shortcuts" so users can reference later. It should open a panel with full list and aliases (Cmd on mac).

matt: implementation detail: expose a small hidden element with id="kbd-help-desc" containing the text for screen readers and set aria-describedby on the scorecard container to that id. Update it only when overlay first shown.

ria: debounce announcements (400ms) so keyboard navigation doesn't cause repeated reads. Also log telemetry events when overlay shown/dismissed so we can measure discoverability improvements.

zoe: agree on telemetry. let's set events: shortcuts_overlay_shown, shortcuts_overlay_dismissed, shortcuts_help_opened. keep them lightweight.

petra: action items: zoe -> mock the overlay and help panel in Figma; matt -> prototype localStorage + telemetry; ria -> a11y pattern doc with aria-live + role recommendations; ux-bot -> create task PROD-4120 and assign.

ux-bot: created task PROD-4120 "Shortcut discovery overlay + help panel" (https://tasks.redwood.ai/4120) assigned to zoe, matt, ria

matt: one more thing — on mobile we shouldn't show the overlay; show a small help link in the header since keyboard isn't primary. I'll add that to the spec.

zoe: perfect. i'll post Figma link and copy variants for translations tomorrow. thanks :raised_hands:
